author: The Babylon Bee
description:
The brand new season of Californians Move To Texas is finally here! As Steve and Timpani continue to adapt to living in Texas, Timpani's sister, Brittuni, shows up and chaos ensues. 

Episode 2 premieres tonight at 7:00 PM Pacific Time.
title: Does Everyone In Texas Have A Gun? #shorts
